camera_sync.limitations: Periodic event matching does not identify same physical exposures. Raster spread and CRC-update phase do not measure sensor exposure timing. CRC interpretation requires the corresponding frozen control; extra live transitions are retained.

fps_diagnostic.primary_verdict: Withdraw 60 fresh input FPS at 1/30 s. Direct 60-mode OSD shows 1/60 s after a 30-mode 1/30 s preselection; original CRC diagnostic fails a frozen-camera control.

entries.label: 30-mode Freeze control
entries.shutter_readback_context: After capture at unchanged 1080p30, before any restoration shutter writes; 1/60 s was visually reviewed.

fps_diagnostic.limitation: Raster cadence, qualified CRC changes and physical exposures differ. Original60 fresh-full-frame claim withdrawn after Freeze failure.

architecture_corrections: 1.93MB is a historical planned storage budget, not current measured on-chip use.
Current renderer: three-row six-camera source ring and256-row,3925-wide destination storage.
DDR source capture rings and output banks are essential; small line caches do not remove frame storage.
C camera-angle matching does not imply pixel equivalence to newest C+INI: stable optical maps/pitch scale retained.
7.468GB/s useful DDR ceiling is analytical, not measured sustained throughput.

bandwidth.scope: Write demand excludes replay reads, refresh, burst arbitration; no measured current30fps guarantee.
